source: Manual transcription of successful read-only Win32 GlobalMemoryStatusEx and PowerShell Get-Process/Stopwatch tool outputs

competing_process_sample.name: gpp
competing_process_sample.method: Copy TotalProcessorTime.TotalSeconds to numeric scalars before and after the wait; elapsed wall time uses Stopwatch ticks

unsuccessful_probes: Win32_OperatingSystem and Win32_Processor CIM queries returned Access denied; no values inferred from them.

An earlier Process.CPU subtraction returned a negative delta because the live Process objects did not provide reliable before/after snapshots. That result is discarded; the scalar snapshot sample is recorded above.
decision: No local Cargo build, workspace tests or solver execution during the competing computation and limited commit headroom. Lightweight Python, source analysis and rustfmt only.
limitations: One short host observation, not a permanent capacity or sustained-load assessment. No other process was interrupted or modified.
